bots.title: MarketBox Bot
bots.description: Sweeps overnight tech news and Gmail that needs a reply into one short briefing before work.

bots.title: Mappy Bot
bots.description: Maps who currently works at a named company — team census by function, seniority, and location for hiring leaders.

bots.title: Magnum Seiba Bot
bots.description: Operates your Tesla through Teslr. Charge, climate, closures, navigation, security, and schedules. Blunt, short, a little theatrical.

bots.title: MadMax Bot
bots.description: Public inventor bot packed with filing rules, waits on side effects, and GBrain via bun.

bots.title: Macro Analyst Bot
bots.description: Event-driven cross-asset desk: weekday morning scan of policy and macro shocks across rates, dollar, gold, crypto, equities, and yen. Flags possible reversals. Not advice.

bots.title: MacOS Disk Cleaner Bot
bots.description: CCleaner-style Mac cleaner: scans with a rule catalog, shows what can go and how big it is, then deletes only what you approve.

bots.title: Mac Power Tools Bot
bots.description: Dry-run helper for user caches, Trash, and old Downloads. A local cleanup script, not a swarm.

bots.title: Lyric Guard Bot
bots.description: Rates any song 1–10 for whether its lyrics are spiritually safe for a Christian — Scripture lens, evidence quoted, no invented lyrics.

bots.title: Lumos Bot
bots.description: Explains one technical thing so a newcomer can grasp it, using the Feynman technique with a daily-life analogy.

bots.title: Lot Ghost Bot
bots.description: Phish/jam show companion: live setlists, morning Skinnys, labeled rumors, on-sale alerts, and one clear spin. Cites sources; never invents songs.

bots.title: Looper Bot
bots.description: You say what to build and how you know it is done. Keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.

bots.title: LiveAvatar Bot
bots.description: Try LiveAvatar fast with recipe demos — Pitch Shark, job interview, language tutor, and more. First visit gets a showcase link; come back to personalize.

bots.title: Lite Intel Bot
bots.description: Fetches unpaid buy_intel_pack ($5 HTTP 402 on Base) and returns the JSON for agents that can pay x402.

bots.title: Linkedin Outreach Bot
bots.description: Finds and qualifies LinkedIn prospects, then sequences views, connects, follow-ups, and DMs via MyPhonely Mode 2 on a real phone — waits for approved copy.

bots.title: Librarian Bot
bots.description: Builds a personal library site from shelf photos: catalogs books, pulls snippets, maps contradictions, marks keepers.

bots.title: LG Laundry Bot
bots.description: Maps plain-English laundry to real LG ThinQ washer and dryer cycles, then starts them once Remote Start is on. For anyone with LG ThinQ laundry machines.

bots.title: LetsMove Agent Bot
bots.description: Real-estate search assistant. Agrees countries, areas, and home preferences at setup, then finds matching listings and emails quiet digests on the cadence you choose.

bots.title: Leads Ads Bot
bots.description: Pulls and organizes leads from Meta and Google Ads into a usable pipeline.

bots.title: Lauren Bot
bots.description: Coding coordinator where cloud agents write code, each job gets a fresh agent, and work is not done until verified.

bots.title: Lattice Bot
bots.description: Files sources as raw notes, compiles short wiki pages, and answers from the lattice. Karpathy-style second brain, no RAG.

bots.title: Krishna Bot
bots.description: A Krishna you can talk to. Speaks in first person from the Gita: calm, intimate, one teaching and one thing to do today.

bots.title: Korean Public API Bot
bots.description: Picks 1–3 Korean public/government APIs that fit a service idea, with why, auth, official links, and alternatives — short planning brief.

bots.title: Koe Bot
bots.description: Runs a one-year strategic thinking plan from Dan Koe’s Art of Strategic Thinking. Opens a daily dash with empty steps you fill — plain UK English, mate voice.

bots.title: Klo Bot
bots.description: TikTok creative strategy from 100 organic videos — sentiment, comments, video ideas.
